target: doctor.sh — the model-size gate parses sizes numerically, so 4B-class models warn and larger ones do not (a digit match reads '12b' as '1')
cmd: check() { S="${1##*:}"; S="${S%[bB]}"; S="${S#[eE]}"; if awk -v s="$S" 'BEGIN{exit !(s+0 > 0 && s+0 <= 4)}'; then echo warn; else echo ok; fi; }; jq -n --arg a "$(check qwen3.5:4b)" --arg b "$(check gemma4:12b)" --arg c "$(check gemma4:e4b)" --arg d "$(check qwen3.5:0.8b)" --arg e "$(check qwen3:8b)" --arg f "$(check llama4:70b)" '{q4:$a, g12:$b, e4:$c, p8:$d, q8:$e, l70:$f}'

provenance.note: captured shim_call events: qwen3.5:4b -> partial (3494 tokens, empty result), gemma4:12b -> ok. All three projects had overridden the shipped default by hand
